Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn’t activate. The effect triggers when a card is removed from a security stack, but this card is removed from the battle area before it can activate.
Card Q&A.q: This Digimon attacked a player and a security check occurred. If this card leaves the battle area due to the revealed card's [Security] effect, does this card’s [Your Turn] effect activate?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon checks your opponent's security stack, if you have 3 or more security cards, gain 1 memory. If you have 2 or fewer, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞.
